chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Natana (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ziyad al-Nahdi, from Ubaydullah ibn Salih, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all). He said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali! Whoever loves me, loves you, and loves the Imams from your descendants, let him praise God for the purity of his birth. For none will love us except one whose birth is pure, and none will hate us except one whose birth is impure.

key_terms.الأئمة من ولدك: The Imams from your descendants — referring to the eleven Imams after Ali
key_terms.طيب المولد: Purity of birth — refers to both legitimate lineage and natural spiritual disposition
key_terms.يحبنا: Loves us — the love of Ahlulbayt as a theological marker

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about loving Ali and the Imams in Al-Amali of Saduq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressed Imam Ali (AS) declaring that love for the Prophet, Ali, and the Imams from Ali's lineage is a sign of pure birth, while enmity toward them indicates an impure origin. This teaching reflects the Shia belief in the spiritual and genealogical dimensions of devotion to Ahlulbayt. The concept of 'pure birth' (طيب المولد) in early Islamic discourse referred not only to legitimate lineage but also to the spiritual fitness of a person's nature, indicating that love or hatred for the household of the Prophet is a fundamental indicator of one's inner purity.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Abi Ziyad al-Nahdi from `Abdullah b. Salih from Zayd b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. `Ali from his father Amir al-Mu'minin `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: O `Ali! Whoever loves me, loves you, and loves the Imams from your descendants should praise Allah for his pure birth, for none will love us except he who is pure of birth, and none will hate us except for he who is impure of birth.
